title: feat(objectql,service-analytics): refuse a raw aggregate over a record-mode quantity unless grouped by its unit field
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvMi1U7R2kBd3JbTPu

Fixes #35491

A total over a quantity whose unit is stored per row (`unitConfig: { unitMode: 'record', unitField }`) is now refused unless it groups by that unit field. Before, 10 KGM plus 10 LBR answered 20 in the engine aggregate, a dataset or cube measure, and a `summary` roll-up. This is ADR-0158 U7 R1, built as a one-for-one mirror of the ADR-0144 D6 record-currency doors.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：按单位逐行记录的数量（如一行 10 千克、一行 10 磅），在报表、数据集和汇总字段里不按单位分组直接求和、求平均、取最大最小时，会得到明确的拒绝提示，而不是一个错误的总数；按单位分组后照常出数。
- 为什么做：属于“计量单位”第一期，直接相加不同单位的数量会得出看似合理却错误的数字，这里与多币种的同类保护保持一致。
- 出错会怎样：目前还没有任何应用或示例使用这种按行记录单位的数量，影响面为零；如有问题，撤回这次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **ObjectQL aggregate door** (`packages/objectql/src/record-unit-aggregate-door.ts`, wired in `ObjectQL.aggregate` right after the record-currency door): `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over a `record`-mode quantity answers `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 before any driver is asked, unless `groupBy` includes the quantity's `unitField`. The message names the quantity, its unit field and the grouping to add; the thrown error carries `field`, `fields`, `object`, `param: 'aggregations'` and `unitField` (in process only: the `/data` REST body keeps `field` and `object` and drops `unitField`, measured below).
- **`summary` registration** (`recordUnitSummaryRefusal`, in `SchemaRegistry.registerObject` beside `recordCurrencySummaryRefusal`): a roll-up of `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over such a child quantity answers `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 (`RecordUnitSummaryRefusedError`), judged at whichever registration completes the pair. Per ADR-0158 L3 every such roll-up is refused in R1 (no `master_detail` following), so the roll-up recompute gets no bypass channel: the currency door needs `ROLLUP_AGGREGATE_OPTION` only for its admitted roll-up, and units admit none.
- **Analytics cube measure door** (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/cube-record-unit-door.ts`, asked right after the record-currency door at all four places that ask it: the inferred, augmented and declared `ensureCube` paths and the draft-preview branch of `queryDataset`): `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, the thrown error carrying `member`, `param: 'measures'`, `field`, `object` and `unitField` (in process only: the analytics REST body is `code` and `message`), unless a dimension's column is the unit field on the same object. The plugin's `sourceFieldMeta` relays `unitField` only for a `number` under `unitMode: 'record'`. The dimension resolver both doors share moved into one private method (`groupedColumnOf`), with no change to what it answers.
- **The widening.** `AnalyticsServiceConfig.sourceFieldMeta` may answer one more optional key, `unitField`: a `number` field's `unitConfig.unitField`, under `unitMode: 'record'` only. `AnalyticsServicePlugin` relays it for a `number` under `unitMode: 'record'` and for nothing else. A host that does not answer it gets no record-unit judgment from the cube door. The precedent is a35fc66, `homeAmountField` on the same answer. The errors' `unitField` member is not part of the widening: no REST envelope carries it.
- Two ADR anchors (new files only) and a patch changeset for `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/service-analytics`.

**The raw-aggregate set, as built** (ADR-0158 Open item 12, the aggregate half; carried to the ADR text by the weekly ADR revisions card #36086, whose row lands after this PR merges): `sum`, `avg`, `min` and `max` are raw. `count` reads no quantity and `count_distinct` adds nothing, so neither is judged. Grouping by the quantity's own `unitField` admits the aggregate. A `fixed`-mode quantity and a `number` field with no `unitConfig` pass unchanged. No new error code: `INVALID_FIELD` and `INVALID_METADATA`, as ADR-0144 assigned for currency.

## Why

ADR-0158 U7 R1: "a build-time refusal of a raw aggregate over a `record`-mode quantity unless it groups by that quantity's unit field (mirrors ADR-0144 D6)". L3: "In R1, a `summary` over `record`-mode child quantities is therefore always refused, as every such currency roll-up was before ADR-0144's D6 amendment".

## Tests

Read first (by risk):

1. `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`: the one new call, after the record-currency door.
2. `packages/objectql/src/registry-object-registration.ts`: the summary refusal beside the currency one.
3. `packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts`: the four call sites and the extracted `groupedColumnOf`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/record-unit-aggregate-door.test.ts` shows 8 passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/record-unit-analytics.test.ts` shows 23 passed.

- `packages/objectql/src/record-unit-aggregate-door.test.ts` (8): ungrouped `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` refused with code, status, field, unit field and the remedy inside the first 500 characters; grouped by another field refused; grouped by the unit field answers `KGM [15, 7.5, 5, 10]`, `LBR [10, 10, 10, 10]`; `count` 3, `count_distinct` 2, fixed-unit `sum` 11 and `max` 6, plain `sum` 6 and `avg` 2; the summary refused at both registration orders and over itself, naming roll-up, quantity and unit field; `count` over the quantity, `sum` over the fixed quantity and the plain number register in both orders and roll up 2, 9 and 5.
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/record-unit-analytics.test.ts` (23, SqlDriver over better-sqlite3, both strategies): grouped values per unit; a totals grouping keeping the unit; refusals (another dimension only, each raw aggregate ungrouped, a grand total) with no read of the object; `count`, `count_distinct`, fixed-unit and plain measures served ungrouped with values; the cube face; the inferred cube refused and then served grouped; the draft preview refused and served grouped.

<details><summary>Before and after, measured on a real engine (ObjectQL over SqlDriver / better-sqlite3)</summary>

The four wiring files restored to `origin/main` for the before run; the probe is a throwaway file, not committed.

| Probe | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `aggregate sum(qty)`, rows 10 KGM and 10 LBR | `20` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 |
| `avg` / `min` / `max` | `10` / `10` / `10` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 each |
| `count(qty)` | `2` | `2` |
| `sum(qty)` grouped by `unit_code` | KGM 10, LBR 10 | KGM 10, LBR 10 |
| `summary` sum over child rows 10 KGM, 10 LBR | registered, stored `20` | `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 at registration |
| dataset `total` ungrouped | `20` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 |
| dataset `total` by unit | KGM 10, LBR 10 | KGM 10, LBR 10 |
| inferred cube `qty_sum` | `20` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 |

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one per door (committed first; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restore proven by blob equality)</summary>

The suites resolve `@objectstack/objectql` and the service to `src` (the service-analytics vitest alias), so no `dist` rebuild sits between mutation and run.

- Aggregate door: delete the `assertRecordUnitAggregatesGrouped(...)` call in `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`: 2 failed / 6 passed (the two refusal pins); restored, blob `691b2595e09a` == HEAD.
- Summary door: delete `if (recordUnitSummary) return { refusal: recordUnitSummary };`: 3 failed / 5 passed (both orders and the self roll-up); restored, blob `fa4c14cb923c` == HEAD.
- Cube door: make the unit arm skip every measure (`if (unitField === undefined || unitField !== undefined) continue;`): 17 failed / 6 passed (every refusal pin on both strategies, the cube face, the inferred cube and the draft preview); restored, blob `dad0d024e94b` == HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Dataset compile, mirrored as currency does it.** Currency's `DATASET_INVALID` compile guards (`measure-currency-coherence.ts`) judge a measure's `currency` key and derived measures across currencies; a dataset that declares an ungrouped `sum` over a record-mode amount compiles, and the refusal rides each query selection through the cube door. Units mirror that: a dataset measure over a record-mode quantity compiles, and every selection that does not group by the unit field is refused `INVALID_FIELD`. A dataset measure has no `unit` key, so guard 1 has no unit twin. A derived measure combining a record-mode quantity with another quantity is not a raw aggregate and is not judged here (no ruling covers it).
- **Two-segment `unitField`.** The object door refuses a dotted `unitField`, so no quantity follows a parent's unit and this door has no path arm (the currency door's `MASTER_DETAIL.CODE` arm has no twin).
- **Repo-wide sweep.** No pin asserted a raw total over a `record`-mode quantity (grep of `unitMode: 'record'` repo-wide: no aggregate, `summary` or dataset measure over one outside this PR's own tests). No `examples/**`, `packages/**/fixtures` or `packages/**/__fixtures__` file declares `unitConfig`, so no example build is broken by the refusal.
- **Declaration basis.** `unitConfig` is not in any released CHANGELOG (`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/objectql/CHANGELOG.md` at 18.6.0 carry no `unitConfig`; its changeset `35489-unit-config.md` is pending), so the refusal narrows nothing published: `Metadata-protocol: none`. The one published-surface change is the optional `sourceFieldMeta` key above, so `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- **`unitField` on the wire, measured.** A throwaway probe in `packages/rest` (not committed) threw each door's real error into the real REST writers. `/data` (`mapDataError`): 400, body keys `error`, `code`, `field`, `object`; the INVALID_FIELD arm copies `field` and `object` only (`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` lines 1308 and 1309). `POST /analytics/dataset/query`: 400, body keys `code`, `message`; the declared-4xx arm writes `code`, `message` and an optional `userMessage` only (`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` line 926). The same holds for the currency twin's `member`, `field` and `object` on the analytics door.
- UI whole-set summary over a record-mode quantity: #36082
- Dataset compile guard (both families) and derived-measure twin: #36083
- ADR-0158 amendment with the raw-aggregate set (the card's last Done-when clause): row on #36086, prerequisite this PR merged.
